answer_text: OAP section 8 sets an average épannelage of R+4 (R+4 moyen) for constructions à destination principale d'habitation in the Joliot-Curie quartier (c-01)[Pour les constructions à destination principale d'habitation, un épannelage des constructions devra permettre d'atteindre un objectif de R+4 moyen.]. The printed page is 32 and the PDF page is 33.
additional_context: The OAP wording is an objective (un objectif de R+4 moyen), not a binding maximum. The planner rationale does not state a numeric OAP value, so no value was contradicted. The UMG R+5 ceiling was not verified in this scoped retrieval and belongs to the height-limit question. A passage on page 25 of the same OAP document gives R+4 moyen for the UM zone (c-02)[A l'échelle de la zone UM, le principe d'épannelage correspond à R+4 moyen.]. That passage is outside the section 8 scope I was given, so it is supporting context only and not the Joliot-Curie answer.
